title: What Makes Verb Different From Other Fashion Brands?
summary:
Fashion today offers endless choices, but finding a brand with a recognisable point of view can make all the difference. Shopverb by Pallavi Singhee brings together Indian craftsmanship, contemporary silhouettes, expressive prints and effortless styling to create clothing that feels distinctive without being difficult to wear.

Founded in 2008 by Pallavi Singhee, Shopverb was created around a design philosophy that combines traditional techniques and influences with modern, globally inspired fashion. The result is a wardrobe that moves between city dressing, holidays, celebrations and everyday occasions.

Shopverb is different because it combines Indian artistry with contemporary Western silhouettes, expressive prints, versatile designs and custom sizing. Instead of separating traditional craftsmanship from modern fashion, Shopverb brings the two together in pieces designed for today's wardrobe.

From the colourful Poppy collection to the effortless Ease collection and the summer-focused Sway | Spring Summer ’26, each collection reflects this approach in a different way.
body:
## How Does Shopverb Combine Indian Craftsmanship With Contemporary Fashion?

Shopverb combines traditional Indian craftsmanship with modern silhouettes and fabrics to create clothing that feels rooted in artistry while remaining relevant to contemporary wardrobes.

Embroidery, detailing and Indian design influences are incorporated into dresses, co-ord sets, kaftans, shirts and other Western-inspired styles. This balance between tradition and modernity is central to Shopverb's design philosophy.

The [Sway | Spring Summer ’26 collection](https://shopverb.com/collections/sway-spring-summer26) reflects this approach through its contemporary take on warm-weather dressing, bringing together expressive design with pieces intended for modern everyday and vacation wardrobes.

## Does Shopverb Focus Only on Statement Fashion?

No. Shopverb also creates pieces designed for relaxed, everyday dressing.

The [Ease Collection](https://shopverb.com/collections/ease) focuses on effortless dressing with styles that can work across different parts of your day. The collection includes pieces suited to resort wear, everyday outfits and relaxed occasions, showing that statement design does not always have to mean complicated styling.

This balance is an important part of the Shopverb approach: clothing can have distinctive prints, details or silhouettes while still being comfortable and easy to incorporate into your wardrobe.

## What Makes Shopverb Clothing Versatile?

Shopverb designs pieces that can work across more than one type of occasion.

A dress can be styled for brunch, a holiday or an evening out. A co-ord can be worn together as a complete look or styled as separate pieces. A shirt or blouse can move from daytime dressing to dinner with a change of accessories.

This versatility is reflected across the brand's collections, which include dresses, tops and blouses, co-ords, jackets, kaftans, shirts, tunics and bottoms.

The idea is simple: your wardrobe should give you options rather than require a completely different outfit for every occasion.

## How Does Shopverb Balance Comfort and Style?

Shopverb focuses on creating clothing that feels considered without losing ease.

The brand's collections include flowing silhouettes, relaxed pieces, lightweight styles, co-ords and resort-inspired designs alongside more structured and occasion-focused outfits.

The [Ease Collection](https://shopverb.com/collections/ease) particularly reflects this idea, with its focus on effortless co-ords and resort wear.

This makes Shopverb relevant not only when you are dressing up, but also when you want to look put together without feeling overdressed.


## Does Shopverb Offer Custom Sizing?

Yes. Custom sizing is available from XS to 3XL across the site.

Customisation is particularly useful for distinctive silhouettes where proportions can affect the overall look of a garment. Instead of relying only on standard sizing, customers can explore custom sizing for a more personalised fit.

This is one of the practical ways Shopverb brings a more personalised approach to online fashion.

## Is Shopverb Only About Dresses?

No. Shopverb offers much more than dresses.

The brand includes all type of collections like:

- Dresses
- Tops and blouses
- Co-ord sets
- Shirts
- Pants and bottoms
- Kaftans
- Tunics
- Jackets

You can explore more [collections](https://shopverb.com/collections) on the website as per your style and preferences.
This variety allows you to build an entire wardrobe around the Shopverb aesthetic rather than relying on one particular category.

From a statement dress for an occasion to an easy co-ord for travel, the pieces are designed to work together across different parts of a woman's wardrobe.

## What Makes Shopverb's Prints and Colours Different?

Colour and print are an important part of Shopverb's design identity. Rather than relying only on minimal or neutral designs, the brand uses expressive colours, artistic prints and detailed surfaces to give its pieces a distinctive character.

The [Poppy Collection](https://shopverb.com/collections/poppy) is a good example, bringing together vibrant prints and feminine silhouettes for resort dressing, holidays and occasions where you want your outfit to have more personality.
